title: Homotopic maps induce equal maps on cohomology, also after an additive functor
statement: Let $\mathcal A$, $\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] and $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ an additive functor. Let $K^\bullet$, $L^\bullet$ be cochain complexes of $\mathcal A$ (indexed by $\mathbf Z$) and $f,g:K^\bullet\to L^\bullet$ morphisms of complexes which are chain-homotopic: there are morphisms $k^n:K^n\to L^{n-1}$ with $f^n-g^n=d_L^{n-1}k^n+k^{n+1}d_K^n$ for all $n$. Then (a) the morphisms $F(f),F(g):F(K^\bullet)\to F(L^\bullet)$ between the complexes obtained by applying $F$ termwise are chain-homotopic, by the morphisms $F(k^n)$; (b) $H^n(f)=H^n(g):H^n(K^\bullet)\to H^n(L^\bullet)$ for every $n$; in particular $H^n(F(f))=H^n(F(g))$.
